environment.description: CLI tool runs on an EC2 instance with IMDSv1 enabled (no token required for metadata). The PostgreSQL database user 'webhook_validator' has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the webhooks database. No network egress filtering. The tool is invoked by an internal job scheduler that accepts URLs from user-submitted webhook registration forms.

config.db_user_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO webhook_validator
config.network: no egress filtering, full outbound access
config.invocation: cron job processes user-submitted URLs from queue
